company.name: Ivvaz
company.tagline: At the confluence of heritage and modern precision — Premium Basmati Rice.
company.shortDescription: Ivvaz is a premier rice milling and export company from India, delivering premium basmati rice to 95+ countries. We combine traditional expertise with world-class processing to serve retailers, restaurants, and distributors with uncompromising quality.
company.story:
Founded with a passion for exceptional rice, Ivvaz emerged from decades of family expertise in rice cultivation and milling. Our journey began in the fertile basmati-growing regions of northern India, where generations of knowledge about grain quality, cooking character, and premium processing have been passed down.

Today, Ivvaz operates a state-of-the-art milling facility with 250+ MT per day processing capacity and 9,000 MT storage. We handpick paddy from trusted farmer networks, process it through advanced cleaning, de-stoning, milling, optical sorting, and polishing lines, then package it with full traceability for export to 25+ countries worldwide.

Our commitment is simple: deliver the finest Indian basmati rice to premium retail chains, fine dining restaurants, foodservice operations, and discerning importers across the globe — every single batch, every single shipment.
company.heroHeadline: Every grain tells a story. Every batch earns your trust.
company.heroSubheadline: From Indian fields to global tables — Ivvaz delivers premium basmati rice shaped by heritage, precision, and the pursuit of perfection in every grain.

processingSteps.title: Paddy Reception
processingSteps.summary: Incoming paddy is received, weighed and sampled.
processingSteps.description: Each consignment of paddy is logged on arrival. Samples are drawn for moisture and quality assessment before the lot is accepted into storage.

processingSteps.title: Cleaning
processingSteps.summary: Dust, straw and light impurities are removed.
processingSteps.description: Pre-cleaning separates dust, chaff, straw and other light foreign matter so that only clean paddy moves forward in the line.

processingSteps.title: De-stoning
processingSteps.summary: Stones and heavy particles are separated.
processingSteps.description: De-stoning removes stones, mud balls and heavier particles that share the size of a paddy grain but differ in density.

processingSteps.title: Milling
processingSteps.summary: Husk and bran layers are removed from the grain.
processingSteps.description: Hulling removes the outer husk, then whitening gently removes the bran layer to reveal the rice kernel while limiting breakage.

processingSteps.title: Optical Sorting
processingSteps.summary: Discoloured and defective grains are rejected.
processingSteps.description: Optical sorting inspects the flow of grains and rejects discoloured, chalky or defective kernels to achieve a uniform appearance.

processingSteps.title: Polishing
processingSteps.summary: Grains are polished to a clean, even finish.
processingSteps.description: Polishing smooths the surface of each kernel, improving lustre, shelf appearance and consistency across the batch.

processingSteps.title: Quality Inspection
processingSteps.summary: Samples are checked against the buyer's specification.
processingSteps.description: Samples from the line are inspected for grain length, broken percentage, moisture and foreign matter before the lot is released.

processingSteps.title: Grading
processingSteps.summary: Rice is graded by length and broken content.
processingSteps.description: Graders separate head rice from brokens and classify the rice by length so that every bag matches its declared grade.

processingSteps.title: Packaging
processingSteps.summary: Rice is weighed, packed and sealed.
processingSteps.description: Graded rice is weighed and packed into the agreed packaging, sealed, labelled and coded for batch traceability.

processingSteps.title: Export
processingSteps.description: Packed rice is loaded into containers with export documentation prepared for customs clearance and shipment to the destination port.

technologies.title: Milling Technology
technologies.description: State-of-the-art rubber roll shellers and horizontal whiteners from leading manufacturers ensure gentle husk removal with minimal breakage, preserving grain integrity.

technologies.title: Automated Processing
technologies.description: Fully automated conveying and processing lines with PLC control systems ensure consistent throughput, minimal human intervention, and precise quality control.

technologies.title: Optical Sorting
technologies.description: Advanced CCD-based optical sorters detect discolored, chalky, and defective grains with 99%+ accuracy, delivering uniform premium-grade rice to every batch.

technologies.title: Advanced Grading
technologies.description: Multi-stage grading systems using indented cylinders and length graders separate head rice from brokens, ensuring every bag meets its declared grade specification.

technologies.title: Quality Inspection
technologies.description: In-house laboratory with moisture meters, Kett whiteness analyzers, and grain analyzers for precise quality assurance at every production stage.

technologies.title: Packaging Technology
technologies.description: Automated weighing, filling, sealing, and labeling machines with high-speed packing lines capable of multiple pack sizes from consumer packs to bulk bags.

technologies.title: Warehouse Management
technologies.description: Climate-controlled storage with 9,000 MT capacity, pest-free facilities, FIFO stock rotation, and digital inventory tracking for freshness and traceability.

technologies.title: Export Preparation
technologies.description: Dedicated container stuffing bays, fumigation facilities, and complete export documentation workflow for seamless international shipments.

qualityChecks.title: Quality Checks
qualityChecks.description: Defined checkpoints at intake, in-process and before dispatch.

qualityChecks.title: Grain Inspection
qualityChecks.description: Length, colour, chalkiness and broken percentage are assessed against specification.

qualityChecks.title: Moisture Testing
qualityChecks.description: Moisture is measured at intake and before packing to protect shelf life in transit.

qualityChecks.title: Sorting
qualityChecks.description: Defective and discoloured kernels are removed from the flow.

qualityChecks.title: Packaging Inspection
qualityChecks.description: Seals, weights, labels and markings are verified before palletising.

qualityChecks.title: Batch Verification
qualityChecks.description: Every lot is coded so that it can be traced back through the process.
